'''Patchogue''' ({{IPAc-en|ˈ|p|æ|tʃ|ɒ|ɡ}} {{respell|PATCH|og}}) is a [[Administrative divisions of New York#Village|village]] located within the [[Brookhaven, New York|Town of Brookhaven]] in [[Suffolk County, New York|Suffolk County]], on the [[South Shore (Long Island)|South Shore]] of [[Long Island]], in [[New York (state)|New York]], United States. The population was 12,408 at the time of the 2020 census.

The '''Incorporated Village of Patchogue''' is located approximately {{convert|60|mi|-1}} east of [[Manhattan]], along the shore of [[Patchogue Bay]] – itself part of the [[Great South Bay]].
